findings.title: A request started before normalClose may complete and hand off a callback after the immutable cutoff
findings.actual: current checks only before each request; createRequestBoundary fixed10000 lacks notAfter cap/check. Response/body and approve result/handoff have no current recheck. FIFO own5sec/30sec waits likewise have no qualified normalClose bound.
findings.deterministicReproduction: Pure installedSDK/mocktransport fixture: finite deadline=start+5000, valid original sameSession. On the only approvePOST the mock advances Date.now to deadline+1 and returns a valid whitelisted callback. approve resolves CALLBACK_HANDED_OFF_ONCE and handoff observes Date.now>normalClose. OnePOST, no external network/credentials.
findings.minimalFix: Bind request timeout/checks to remaining immutable notAfter, reject responses/body/admission after cutoff; recheck before sensitive callback handoff. Propagate same qualified cutoff to FIFO waits and actual write/read admission, so waiting cannot deliver after normalClose. Preserve at-most-onePOST and UNKNOWN_NO_RETRY after attempted POST; no retry or claim of NOT_SUBMITTED. Add focused slowGET/POST/deadline/FIFO late-delivery negatives.
